rows.name: Steakhouse Financial

farm_plan.text: Use a fresh wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, and keep its seed phrase offline.
farm_plan.cost: $3 of gas for the first transaction

farm_plan.text: Deposit $150 into a Steakhouse Financial vault on Base and keep the shares.
farm_plan.cost: $150 of capital, about $8 of gas and $1 of round-trip fees

farm_plan.text: Make one qualifying action each week, such as a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a vote, and repeat it on Ethereum if the protocol counts both chains.
farm_plan.cost: about $2 of gas a week for 5 weeks

farm_plan.text: Hold the position for at least 30 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot.
farm_plan.cost: the $150 stays in the position

farm_plan.text: Open Steakhouse Financial's official docs and rewards page, confirm the points season and snapshot dates, and use only the claim link the protocol publishes.
farm_plan.cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim

farm_plan.text: After the qualifying window closes, claim or withdraw in one transaction and keep the receipt.
farm_plan.cost: about $2 of claim gas

farm_plan.text: Write the wallet, the dates, every transaction and the implied value in a farm log so you can repeat the position or unwind it.
farm_plan.cost: nothing but the log
